estimates.assumptions: 1.5 lb chicken breast assumed as 680g edible raw boneless skinless portion (standard conversion: 1 lb = 453.6g).
2 tbs cornstarch (common 'starch' in Chinese recipes) at ~8g per tbs; standard calorie density for dry cornstarch.
1/2 tsp onion salt; modest volume-to-mass for seasoning (~6g/tsp), treated as negligible calories like table salt.
1 tbs rice vinegar; standard ~15g per tablespoon with very low calorie density.
1/2 tbs gochujang (fermented chili paste); ~18g per tbs estimated, typical calorie density for this ingredient.
2 tbs cornstarch (common 'starch' in Chinese recipes) at ~8g per tbs; standard calorie density for dry cornstarch.
2 chopped spring onions (scallions); realistic ~15g per medium onion, using supplied calorie density.
